issues.problem: The strict library's SCOPE for the projective category (Benzecri/Structure/Quotient.lean l.77–82) plans § 2's equivalence on the full subcategory `ConnectedSpace V ∧ T2Space V` of GXCat. ConeCat's objects carry no connectedness. V ↦ V/ℝ₊* then sends a disconnected cone object outside that subcategory (and the inverse functor can never reach it), so the two object predicates would not correspond. DEC-122 fixed the Hausdorff half of the match; the connectedness half (and second countability, if the projective side carries it) is still open.
issues.fix: Before wave 4: either add `ConnectedSpace V` (and `SecondCountableTopology V` if the projective side has it) to IsProperConeObject (ConeBase.connectedSpace and ConeBase.secondCountableTopology already give the forward direction), or take the projective side on `T2Space` alone. Record the choice in this SCOPE. Author question below.
